resolutions.researcher_notes: Egypt Oil & Gas Newspaper's Sept-2020 'Crude Oil Squad' report tables Egypt's seven Gulf of Suez/Sinai gas pipelines, including 'Zaafarana-Korimat' (From: Zaafarana, To: Korimat Power Station) as active infrastructure. A separate July-2024 egyptoil-gas.com feature independently names the same 'Zaafarana-Korimat' line among the seven, still carrying gas to Korimat Power Station, corroborating it as operating 4 years later. Both are egyptoil-gas.com pieces (different authors/dates) so held at medium rather than high. url_verifier's automated screen fails on this PDF's multi-column table layout (digits/words get reordered across cells during text extraction) -- hand-confirmed via `pdftotext -layout` that 'Zaafarana', 'Korimat' etc. are genuinely present (standing rule 8: screen miss, not a verdict).

Both articles list Zaafarana-Korimat under 'Natural Gas Infrastructure' / the Gulf-of-Suez-to-Sinai natural gas pipelines, confirming Fuel = Gas. Same-outlet caveat as Status unit; PDF table extraction quirk hand-confirmed via pdftotext -layout.

Source tables the line as a 163 km / 18-inch trunk carrying gas from the Zaafarana field area to Korimat Power Station -- a dedicated long-haul transmission line, not a local distribution network. PipelineType=transmission is a direct inference from that description, not a literal label on the page. Single source, medium tier. PDF extraction quirk (see Status unit) hand-confirmed via pdftotext -layout.

The article's Natural Gas Infrastructure table gives Zaafarana-Korimat a capacity of exactly 105 mmcf/d, matching the sheet's 105.00 MMcf/d. Single source, medium tier. url_verifier's automated screen misses this because the table's columns interleave digits from adjacent rows during text extraction; hand-confirmed present via `pdftotext -layout` (standing rule 8 -- screen miss, not a verdict).

Same table gives Zaafarana-Korimat a length of exactly 163 km, matching the sheet's 163.00 km. Single source, medium tier. PDF table extraction quirk hand-confirmed via pdftotext -layout (see Status unit note).

Both articles give the pipeline's route as From: Zaafarana To: Korimat Power Station, matching StartLocation=Zaafarana and EndPrefecture/District=Kuraimat Power Station. Neither source states the sheet's province labels (Gulf of Suez / Giza) so those sub-fields are unconfirmed but not contradicted. Same-outlet caveat as Status unit.
